items.title: Bob Havens interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: But he and Pete Fountain and I were the original members of the front line of this band in 1957.

ctx.x: Yeah. Here I’ve only been with Flanagan one month and now I’m on Bourbon Street and I get another offer, and it took me about ten seconds to decide I’d rather play Dixieland than the big band. I finished the tour with Flanagan and four months later I came back to New Orleans and played with George’s band. And I was in New Orleans for five years. And I played with George and after a year or two I switched over to Al Hirt’s jazz band. And Al had started a band. Of course you know in later years he became a big name…
awfully well in his career, and so I got my start in New Orleans. I call it my apprenticeship in jazz.
